# Yekeen Maadan — maadan.dev

> Full-stack software developer and AI engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria. Builds production AI tools, Go backends, and React/Next.js frontends. Open to remote freelance, part-time, or full-time engagements.

## About

Yekeen Maadan (brand: Maadan Dev) is a Mathematics graduate and self-taught software developer specializing in AI-augmented product development. He combines deterministic backend engineering in Go and Python with modern React/Next.js frontends and production LLM integrations.

Currently enrolled in the Learn2Earn AI Engineering Fellowship (Cohort 2, July 2026) — a 24-month selective AI engineering program (selected from ~50,000 applicants).

## Core Stack

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go
- Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Go, Python, Supabase (PostgreSQL), REST APIs
- AI/ML: Gemini API, SSE streaming pipelines, LLM orchestration
- Deployment: Vercel, Railway, Cloudflare

## Notable Projects

### NextRole NG
AI-powered CV optimization tool built for the Nigerian job market. Two-phase Gemini processing pipeline running over a Go backend with Server-Sent Events streaming to a React client. Generates ATS-compliant PDFs in real time.

### tools.maadan.dev
Client-facing document automation platform. Legal deed and agreement generator built with Next.js and @react-pdf/renderer for Davidorlah Nigeria Limited. Resolved complex font rendering and ligature bugs in production PDF output.

### ATEKER Luxury Safaris
Frontend client project delivered for a Canadian hospitality brand.
